Theorem
[Poincare's inequality for $W_0^{1,p}$, $1 \le p < n$] ↗ def:sobolev-space-zero-boundary ↗ thm:gagliardo-nirenberg-sobolev-inequality 1. ch5:5.6-thm-3\group Sobolev Inequalities

Assume $U$ is a bounded, open subset of $\R ^n$. Suppose $u \in W_0^{1,p}(U)$ for some $1 \le p < n$. Then we have the estimate \[ \| u\| _{L^q(U)} \le C\| Du\| _{L^p(U)} \] for each $q \in [1, p^*]$, the constant $C$ depending only on $p, q, n$ and $U$.

Proof

\sketch Approximate by compactly supported smooth functions, extend them by zero, and apply the global Gagliardo–Nirenberg–Sobolev estimate. The finite measure of $U$ gives all exponents $q\le p^*$.

□
